assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

substitutions.detail: the run's client is its recipe's `sa-bench` benchmark (srt-slurm), not InferenceX's benchmark_serving.py; the replay sends the InferenceX client's seed-0 request lengths, and the recipe's benchmark draws its own random prompts (range ratio 0.8 and the counts are assumed equal), with the chat template on (its default), which can shift the sent lengths

substitutions.detail: job log expired; the client's flags are assumed to be the launcher's defaults

substitutions.detail: the run's inter-node fabric class is recorded by no launch configuration or recipe; ib-800g is assumed (documented by InferenceX: RoCEv2 Ethernet, 800 Gb/s per chip, ConnectX-8 2x400GbE (https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/gpu-specs (fetched 2026-11-12, sha256 f9ca3c284ebe0c7c8489611996f22ffcedd8fba562b55106f61f1e29a7ab25d8)); the catalog has no RoCE class of that rate, so ib-800g, the class of the same line rate, stands in (assumed, labelled): the nominal rate is the documented one, and the RoCE efficiency is not measured, so the registry's ib-800g value is carried over), so a cross-node transfer is priced at that class's nominal rate times the registry's fabric efficiency
substitutions.subject: cluster.fabric

substitutions.detail: the decode pool's engine arguments are those of InferenceX recipe benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/vllm/minimax-m2.5-b300/8k1k/tp8-1p1d.yaml at the run's commit 6a5a06901b41cf772641619931ef8f2517470e03 (CONFIG_FILE recipes/vllm/minimax-m2.5/8k1k/tp8-1p1d.yaml), not the run's server log, which is one worker's or gone; fields the recipe states: enable_expert_parallel, gpu_memory_utilization, kv_cache_dtype, kv_transfer_config, max_cudagraph_capture_size, max_model_len, max_num_batched_tokens, no_enable_prefix_caching, stream_interval, tensor_parallel_size; sizes the recipe leaves at vLLM's default, equal to the pool's GPUs: data_parallel_size, pipeline_parallel_size

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b300, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/blis-registry#73), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m2.5-nvfp4//decode/linear/ep4: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)
